thread:
maria: Quick check: do we add a first-class "stability" field to model manifests or extend pins?
jon: Pins today conflate affinity+owner+temp; router logic brittle.
lee: Evictions in Dedicated reveal fallback surprises.
sasha: Idea: add stability enum (stable, canary, experimental, deprecated) + optional numeric score. Alternative: keep pins and add pin.type/pin.priority.
maria: Enum + score gives router a single numeric signal for weighted routing; pin-extensions keep shape but add parsing.
jon: Tenant exceptions: customers may want experimental in some regions. Keep overrides in route config not manifest.
anya: Agreed. Manifests = source of truth for model intent; route-level exception lists reference model_id.
lee: Migration: unknown/missing stability should default to experimental for safety. CI warns if absent.
sasha: Suggested mapping: stable=0.9, canary=0.75, experimental=0.4, deprecated=0.1. Manifest can override score and include "stability_reason".
maria: Rollout hints (transition windows & cohort ramps) live in rollout metadata object, not main manifest.
jon: Telemetry: emit model_stability & stability_score on traces and metrics.
anya: Action items: Sasha -> PR for manifest.schema v2; Jon -> router docs; Lee -> tracing; Anya -> Dedicated migration guide; Maria -> ops coordination.
ops-bot: note: CI will warn for manifests without stability field; infra to discuss enforcement.
maria: Small rule: deprecated is advisory, never auto-delete. Sync Friday 10:00 after PR. :thumbsup:
